description: Public JSON feed for the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. The catalog lists vulnerabilities known to be exploited in the wild and includes vendor, product, required-action, due-date, ransomware-use, CWE, and notes metadata.

tools.name: sites_get-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog
tools.description: Returns the current CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, including catalog metadata and the full vulnerability list.
